blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Harmful content appears in diverse forms, ranging from multimodal memes targeting protected groups to textual prompts designed to elicit unsafe responses from large language models. However, existing Arabic resources typically study these settings separately and often rely on coarse-grained labels. We introduce ArGuard , a shared task on harmful content detection in Arabic memes and LLM prompts. ArGuard consists of two tracks: Track A focuses on multimodal hate detection in Arabic memes, while Track B addresses harmful prompt detection for Arabic LLM safety evaluation. Overall, 58 teams registered for the shared task, 35 participated in the final evaluation phase, and 27 submitted system-description papers. Participating systems explored a range of approaches, including fine-tuning encoder- and decoder-based models such as AraBERT, Jais, and Qwen3-VL. The best-performing systems achieved macro-F1 scores of 0.823 on Subtask A1, 0.419 on Subtask A2, 0.984 on Subtask B1, and 0.790 on Subtask B2. These results highlight fine-grained meme classification (Subtask A2) as the most challenging setting, partly due to sparse labels and train-test distribution shifts. To facilitate further research on Arabic harmful-content detection, we release the task datasets and associated resources through the shared-task website.
blocks.zh: 有害的内容以多种形式出现,从针对受保护群体的多式联运计量元件到旨在从大语言模型中获取不安全反应的文字提示。 然而,现有的阿拉伯语资源通常单独研究这些设置,并经常依赖粗糙的标签. 我们介绍ArGuard, 这是一项共同的任务, 阿尔盖德由两条轨道组成: 音轨 一个重点是用阿拉伯元件检测多种模式的仇恨,而轨道B则处理阿拉伯文LLM安全评价的有害及时检测。 共有58个小组登记参加共同任务,35个小组参加了最后评价阶段,27个小组提交了系统说明文件。 参与系统探索了一系列方法,包括微调编码器和解码器模型,如AraBERT,Jais,和Qune3-VL. 表现最好的系统在子任务A1,0.419在子任务A2,0.984在子任务B1和0.790在子任务B2上实现了宏-F1的分数. 这些结果凸显出精细的膜分类(Subtask A2)是最具有挑战性的设定,部分原因是标签稀少和列车测试分布转移. 为了促进进一步研究阿拉伯有害内容检测,我们通过共享任务网站发布任务数据集和相关资源.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: People increasingly encounter harmful Arabic content in different settings. On social media, memes can target protected groups through combinations of images, embedded text, humor, sarcasm, and cultural references Abouzied et al. (2025) ; Sharma et al. (2022) ; Alam et al. (2022) . In interactions with large language models (LLMs), users can submit prompts that request harmful information or attempt to bypass safety safeguards. Reliable detection is therefore important both for preventing harmful content and avoiding unnecessary restrictions on benign content. A system may otherwise allow harmful content, misclassify culturally specific expressions, or block benign content using sensitive language.
blocks.zh: 人们越来越多地在不同的环境中遇到有害的阿拉伯语内容。 在社交媒体上,memes可以通过组合图像,嵌入文本,幽默,讽刺,以及文化参考文献Abouzied等人(2025年);Sharma等人(2022年);Alam等人(2022年)来锁定受保护群体. 在与大语言模型(LLM)的互动中,用户可以提交请求有害信息的提示或者试图绕过安全保障. 因此,可靠的检测对于防止有害内容和避免对良性内容的不必要的限制都很重要。 否则,一个系统可能允许有害内容,对文化上特有的表达方式进行错误分类,或用敏感语言阻断良性内容。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the ArGuard tracks and subtasks. Top: Track A covers binary (A1) and fine-grained (A2) Arabic hateful meme detection. Bottom: Track B covers binary safety (B1) and fine-grained harm-category (B2) classification of LLM prompts.
blocks.zh: 图1:ArGuard轨道和子任务概述. 顶部 : 音轨 A封面二进制(A1)和细纹(A2)阿拉伯仇恨的meme检测. 底部 : 音轨 B覆盖二元安全(B1)和LLM提示的细纹伤害类(B2)分类.

blocks.en: Detecting such content is particularly challenging in Arabic, which spans Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and regional dialects with substantial differences in vocabulary, spelling, and grammar Al-Khalifa et al. (2025) . Online communication adds code-switching, unconventional spelling, and Arabizi, while harmful intent may be expressed indirectly through euphemisms, sarcasm, stereotypes, or culturally specific references. These challenges extend to LLM safety, where safeguards vary across models and harm categories, and Arabic transliteration can weaken protections ( Al Ghanim et al., 2024 ; Ashraf et al., 2025 ; Mubarak et al., 2025 ) . Together, these factors make Arabic harmful-content detection linguistically and culturally challenging.
blocks.zh: 在阿拉伯语中检测这些内容尤其具有挑战性,阿拉伯语涵盖现代标准阿拉伯语(MSA)和区域方言,在词汇、拼写和语法Al-Khalifa et al.(2025)方面差别很大。 在线通信增加了代码切换,非常规拼写,以及Arabizi,而有害的用意则可以通过委婉语,讽刺语,刻板印象或文化上的特异性来间接表达. 这些挑战延伸到LLM安全,各种模型和伤害类别在保障方面各不相同,阿拉伯语转写可能会削弱保护(Al Ghanim等人,2024年;Ashraf等人,2025年;Mubarak等人,2025年)。 这些因素加在一起使阿拉伯文有害内容在语言和文化上具有挑战性。

blocks.en: Memes add another layer of complexity as their meaning often emerges from the interaction between image and text Shahroor et al. (2026) . The Hateful Memes Challenge demonstrated the need to jointly interpret both modalities to distinguish harmful examples from benign confounders ( Kiela et al., 2020 ; Kmainasi et al., 2025 ) . This becomes harder when memes rely on local public figures, dialectal expressions, visual stereotypes, or shared cultural knowledge. Arabic resources such as ArMeme, ArAIEval, and MAHED have advanced the study of propaganda and harmful content in memes ( Alam et al., 2024 ; Zaghouani et al., 2025 ; Hasanain et al., 2023 ) , while recent work has explored reasoning-based methods for more explainable predictions ( Kmainasi et al., 2026a ) . However, most resources focus on propaganda or binary harm labels, offering limited insight into how attacks are expressed or why non-hateful memes may still contain sarcasm, humor, or mockery. AHA-Memes addresses this gap with fine-grained annotations of hateful attack types and non-hateful subtypes ( Kmainasi et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: Memes增加了另一层复杂性,因为其含义往往产生于图像与文本Shahroor等人(2026年)之间的相互作用. " 仇恨的梅姆斯挑战 " 表明,需要共同解释这两种模式,以区分有害的例子和良性的创始人(Kiela等人,2020年;Kmainasi等人,2025年)。 当迷因依赖当地公众人物、方言表达、视觉定型观念或共享文化知识时,这一点就变得更加困难。 ArMeme、ArAIEval和MAHED等阿拉伯语资源推动了对mem的宣传和有害内容的研究(Alam等人,2024年;Zaghouani等人,2025年;Hasanain等人,2023年),而最近的工作则探索了以推理为基础的方法,以便作出更合理的预测(Kmainasi等人,2026a年)。 然而,大多数资源都集中在宣传或二进制伤害标签上,对攻击是如何表达的或者为什么非仇恨的memes仍然可能包含讽刺,幽默,或嘲讽等内容提供了有限的见解. AHA-Memes用对仇恨攻击类型和非仇恨亚型的精细说明来弥补这一缺口(Kmainasi等人,2026年b).

blocks.en: A related challenge arises in LLM interactions, where systems must identify harmful requests before generating a response. Benchmarks such as HarmBench and WildGuard have advanced safety evaluation and guard-model development ( Mazeika et al., 2024 ; Han et al., 2024 ) . However, LLM safety research remains largely English-centric ( Yong et al., 2025 ) . Recent Arabic benchmarks address this gap with culturally relevant prompts and evaluations of Arabic-centric and multilingual models ( Ashraf et al., 2025 ; Mubarak et al., 2025 ) . ArabicDialectSafety further shows that safety performance varies across dialects and harm categories ( Zaghouani et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 一个相关的挑战是LLM相互作用,在这种相互作用中,系统必须先确定有害的请求,然后再做出反应。 Harm Bench和WildGuard等基准具有先进的安全评价和警卫模式发展(Mazeika等人,2024年;Han等人,2024年)。 然而,LLM安全研究基本上仍然是以英语为中心的(Yong等人,2025年)。 近期的阿拉伯语基准利用以阿拉伯语和多语种为中心的模式在文化上相关的提示和评价来解决这一差距(Ashraf等人,2025年;Mubarak等人,2025年)。 ArabianDialectSafety进一步表明,不同方言和伤害类别的安全性能不同(Zaghouani等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Shared tasks have established common evaluation settings for Arabic content moderation. OSACT4 and OSACT5 focused on offensive language and hate speech, while ArAIEval and MAHED extended evaluation to propaganda and multimodal harmful content ( Mubarak et al., 2020 ; Mubarak et al., 2022 ; Hasanain et al., 2024 ; Zaghouani et al., 2025 ) . However, harmful-content detection in multimodal memes and LLM prompts has largely been evaluated separately. Building on these efforts, we introduce the ArGuard 2026 Shared Task , which brings both settings into a common evaluation framework. ArGuard comprises two tracks and four subtasks covering binary and fine-grained classification in both settings.
blocks.zh: 共同的任务为阿拉伯文内容节制建立了共同的评价环境。 OSACT4和OSACT5侧重于攻击性语言和仇恨言论,而ARIEval和MAHED则将评价范围扩大到宣传和多模式有害内容(Mubarak等人,2020年;Mubarak等人,2022年;Hasanain等人,2024年;Zaghouani等人,2025年)。 然而,在多式联运中检测有害物质和LLM提示大多是分开评估的。 在这些努力的基础上,我们提出了 " ArGuard 2026共同任务 " ,将两者纳入共同评价框架。 ArGuard包含两个音轨和四个子任务,涵盖两个设置中的二进制和精细分类.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • We release Arabic safety datasets with fine-grained annotations of hateful attack types, non-hateful meme phenomena, and prompt harm categories, covering MSA and dialects. • We establish reproducible evaluation protocols with task-specific baselines, metrics, format checkers, and scoring tools for both multimodal and textual safety settings. • We analyze participating systems, comparing model families, fusion strategies, class imbalance, and ensembling across the four subtasks.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们发布阿拉伯安全数据集,其中对仇恨攻击类型、非仇恨的mememe现象和迅速伤害类别作了精细的说明,涵盖了MSA和方言。 我们为多式联运和文本安全设置制定可复制的评价协议,包括具体任务的基线、衡量标准、格式检查器和评分工具。 我们分析参与系统,比较模范家庭,聚变策略,阶级不平衡,以及跨越四个子任务的综艺.

blocks.en: We release Arabic safety datasets with fine-grained annotations of hateful attack types, non-hateful meme phenomena, and prompt harm categories, covering MSA and dialects.
blocks.zh: 我们发布阿拉伯安全数据集, 上面有关于仇恨攻击类型的细微说明, 非仇恨的meme现象,

blocks.en: We establish reproducible evaluation protocols with task-specific baselines, metrics, format checkers, and scoring tools for both multimodal and textual safety settings.
blocks.zh: 我们为多式联运和文本安全设置制定了可复制的评价协议,并附有具体任务的基线、衡量标准、格式核对器和评分工具。

blocks.en: We analyze participating systems, comparing model families, fusion strategies, class imbalance, and ensembling across the four subtasks.
blocks.zh: 我们分析参与系统,比较模范家庭,聚变策略,阶级不平衡,以及跨越四个子任务的综艺.

blocks.en: Findings. Our analysis highlights several findings. (i) Fine-grained classification is substantially harder than binary detection, particularly for memes, where the best macro-F1 drops from 0.823 on A1 to 0.419 on A2; sparse and imbalanced fine-grained labels further contribute to this difficulty. (ii) For memes, OCR text carries much of the predictive signal, although the strongest systems benefit from multimodal VLMs, ensembling, and class-aware training. (iii) On prompt safety, train-test shifts in class priors and sources affect generalization, with distribution-aware strategies, external data, or zero-shot LLMs performing robustly. Overall, fine-grained multimodal classification remains the most challenging setting.
blocks.zh: 发现。 我们的分析突出了若干结论。 (一)精细的分类比二进制检测要难得多,特别是对memes而言,其中最好的宏F1从A1上的0.823降至A2上的0.419;稀疏和不平衡的精细的标签进一步加重了这一困难. (二) 对于memes,OCR文本携带许多预测信号,尽管最强的系统受益于多式VLM,综艺,以及班级意识训练. (三)在即时安全方面,班次前科和源头的列车测试班次影响通俗化,分布感知策略,外部数据,或零镜头的LLMs运行有力. 总体而言,精细的多式联运分类仍然是最具挑战性的环境。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The Hateful Memes Challenge established hate detection in memes as a cross-modal problem requiring joint reasoning over image and text ( Kiela et al., 2020 ) . Subsequent work explored multimodal fusion, external knowledge, visual-to-text prompting, and explanation-based reasoning ( Kumar and Nandakumar, 2022 ; Cao et al., 2022 ; Sharma et al., 2022 ; Kmainasi et al., 2025 ) . MultiOFF and MAMI extended this setting to political and misogynistic memes with more detailed labels, while recent work expanded coverage across languages and cultures ( Suryawanshi et al., 2020 ; Fersini et al., 2022 ; Bui et al., 2025 ; Shahroor et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, the literature remains largely English-centric or relies on small non-English datasets.
blocks.zh: " 仇恨的记忆挑战 " 确定,在记忆中发现仇恨是一个跨模式问题,需要对图像和文字进行联合推理(Kiela等人,2020年)。 随后的工作探讨了多式联运、外部知识、视觉到文字的提示和基于解释的推理(Kumar和Nandakumar,2022年;Cao等人,2022年;Sharma等人,2022年;Kmainasi等人,2025年)。 MultiOFF和MAMI将这一设定扩展到政治和厌恶女性的迷因,并有更详细的标签,而最近的工作扩大了语言和文化的覆盖面(Suryawanshi等人,2020年;Fersini等人,2022年;Bui等人,2025年;Shahroor等人,2026年)。 尽管如此,文献仍然基本上以英语为中心,或者依赖于小型的非英语数据集.

blocks.en: Arabic harmful-content research initially focused on text, with OSACT4 and OSACT5 evaluating offensive language, hate speech, and fine-grained hate categories ( Mubarak et al., 2020 ; Mubarak et al., 2022 ) . Multimodal work later addressed propaganda and hate through ArMeme, ArAIEval, SemEval-2024, and MAHED ( Alam et al., 2024 ; Hasanain et al., 2024 ; Dimitrov et al., 2024 ; Zaghouani et al., 2025 ) . AHA-Memes further provides 5,000 Arabic memes with binary hate labels and fine-grained annotations of hateful attack types and non-hateful subtypes ( Kmainasi et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 阿拉伯语有害内容研究最初以文字为主, OSACT4和OSACT5评价攻击性语言、仇恨言论和微弱的仇恨类别(Mubarak等人,2020年;Mubarak等人,2022年)。 多式联运工作后来通过ArMeme、ArAIEval、SemEval-2024和MAHED来解决宣传和仇恨问题(Alam等人,2024年;Hasanain等人,2024年;Dimitrov等人,2024年;Zaghouani等人,2025年)。 AHA-Memes还提供了5000个阿拉伯memes的二进制仇恨标签和细微的描述仇恨攻击类型和非仇恨亚型(Kmainasi等人,2026b).

blocks.en: HarmBench and WildGuard have advanced LLM safety evaluation through standardized red-teaming and moderation benchmarks ( Mazeika et al., 2024 ; Han et al., 2024 ) . However, multilingual safety research remains largely English-centric ( Yong et al., 2025 ) . For Arabic, prior work shows that transliteration and Arabizi can weaken safeguards ( Al Ghanim et al., 2024 ) . Recent resources include culturally adapted safety questions ( Ashraf et al., 2025 ) , AraSafe for fine-grained prompt safety ( Mubarak et al., 2025 ) , and FanarGuard for bilingual Arabic–English moderation ( Fatehkia et al., 2026 ) . ArabicDialectSafety extends this direction with 25,071 human-curated prompts across MSA and five regional dialects, supporting binary safety detection and classification over seven harm categories ( Zaghouani et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: Harm Bench和WildGuard通过标准化的红色小组和节制基准,推进了LLM安全评价(Mazeika等人,2024年;Han等人,2024年)。 然而,多语种安全研究基本上仍然是以英语为中心的(Yong等人,2025年)。 就阿拉伯语而言,先前的研究表明,转写和Arabizi可削弱保障措施(Al Ghanim等人,2024年)。 最近的资源包括适应文化特点的安全问题(Ashraf 等人,2025年),AraSafe用于精细快速安全(Mubarak 等人,2025年),FanarGuard用于双语阿拉伯语英语节制(Fatehkia等人,2026年)。 ArabianDialectSafety将这一方向延伸至25,071个人测的提示,跨越MSA和5个区域方言,支持二进制安全探测和分类7个伤害类别(Zaghouani等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: 3 Tasks and Datasets
blocks.zh: 3 任务和数据集

blocks.en: 3.1 Track A Multimodal Hateful Meme Understanding
blocks.zh: 3.1 轨道A 多式联运 讨厌 记忆理解

blocks.en: Track A evaluates harmful-content detection in Arabic memes. Each instance contains a meme image and its OCR-extracted text. The track comprises two subtasks.
blocks.zh: 轨迹A评价阿拉伯元件中的有害内容检测. 每个实例都包含一个meme图像及其OCR提取的文本. 赛道包括两个子任务.

blocks.en: • Subtask A1 performs binary classification between Hateful and Not Hateful . A meme is considered hateful when it directly or indirectly attacks people based on a protected characteristic, such as race, religion, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or disease ( Kiela et al., 2020 ) . Offensive content that does not target a protected group is labeled Not Hateful . • Subtask A2 performs fine-grained multi-label classification over a unified ten-label taxonomy. The hateful attack types are Mocking , Incitement , Dehumanization , Slurs , Contempt , Inferiority , and Exclusion . The non-hateful subtypes are Humor and Sarcasm , while Other applies to either class. A meme may receive multiple fine-grained labels.
blocks.zh: • 分任务A1对仇恨和非仇恨进行二进制分类。 当因种族、宗教、国籍、性别、性取向、残疾或疾病等受保护特征而直接或间接攻击他人时, 攻击性内容不针对受保护群体, • 子任务A2对统一的十标签分类法进行精细的多标签分类。 仇恨攻击类型包括嘲笑、煽动、非人化、流言蜚语、蔑视、放肆和排斥。 非憎恶的亚型为Humor和Sarcasm,其他则适用于任一类. 一个meme可能会收到多个精细的标签.

blocks.en: Subtask A1 performs binary classification between Hateful and Not Hateful . A meme is considered hateful when it directly or indirectly attacks people based on a protected characteristic, such as race, religion, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or disease ( Kiela et al., 2020 ) . Offensive content that does not target a protected group is labeled Not Hateful .
blocks.zh: 子任务 A1 执行 仇恨 和 非仇恨 之间的二进制 。 当因种族、宗教、国籍、性别、性取向、残疾或疾病等受保护特征而直接或间接攻击他人时, 攻击性内容不针对受保护群体,

blocks.en: Subtask A2 performs fine-grained multi-label classification over a unified ten-label taxonomy. The hateful attack types are Mocking , Incitement , Dehumanization , Slurs , Contempt , Inferiority , and Exclusion . The non-hateful subtypes are Humor and Sarcasm , while Other applies to either class. A meme may receive multiple fine-grained labels.
blocks.zh: 子任务A2在统一的十标签分类法上进行精细的多标签分类. 仇恨攻击类型包括嘲笑、煽动、非人化、流言蜚语、蔑视、放肆和排斥。 非憎恶的亚型为Humor和Sarcasm,其他则适用于任一类. 一个meme可能会收到多个精细的标签.

blocks.en: Both subtasks require systems to combine textual and visual evidence because hate may emerge from the relationship between the image and its overlaid text.
blocks.zh: 两个子任务都要求系统将文字证据和视觉证据结合起来,因为仇恨可能来自图像与其上盖文字之间的关系.

blocks.en:
For this track, we use AHA-Memes, which consists of 5,000 manually annotated Arabic memes ( Kmainasi et al., 2026b ) . The memes were collected from public sources on Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, and Twitter/X, followed by duplicate removal and OCR-based filtering to retain instances containing both visual and textual content. The memes were annotated by trained native Arabic speakers using bilingual guidelines that account for dialectal and culturally specific cues. Inter-annotator agreement, measured using Cohen’s κ \kappa and macro-averaged across labels and annotator pairs, reaches 0.91 for the binary label, 0.75 for hateful types, and 0.67 for non-hateful subtypes, corresponding to substantial to near-perfect agreement ( Landis and Koch, 1977 ) .
The resulting dataset pairs each meme image and its OCR-extracted text with a binary hate label and one or more fine-grained labels. In Figure 2 , we show examples of hateful and non-hateful memes with their corresponding A1 and A2 labels. Further details are provided in Kmainasi et al. (2026b) .
blocks.zh:
对于这个赛道,我们使用AHA-Memes,它由5000个手动附加说明的阿拉伯赛道(Kmainasi等人,2026b)组成. 从Facebook、Instagram、Pinterest和Twitter/X等公共来源收集了这些元数据,随后又进行了重复删除和基于OCR的过滤,以保留包含视觉和文字内容的实例。 受过培训的讲阿拉伯语的当地人用双语准则对这些主题作了说明,这些准则考虑到方言和文化方面的特定提示。 用 Cohen 的 ox\kappa 测量并跨标签和注释对等的宏平均值的注释员协议,二进制标签达到0.91,仇恨型为0.75,非仇恨型为0.67,相当于实质到接近完美的协议(Landis和Koch,1977年)。
由此产生的数据集将每个 meme 图像及其OCR 提取的文本配上二进制的仇恨标签和一个或多个精细的标签. 在图2中,我们用对应的A1和A2标签显示仇恨和非仇恨的迷因。 详见Kmainasi等人(2026年b).。

blocks.en:
In Table 1 , we summarize the four data splits. During development, participants trained on train and dev and submitted predictions for dev_test . We released the dev_test labels afterward, providing 4,500 labeled memes for final training. The remaining 500 memes form the blind test set.
Among the labeled splits, 37.8% of memes are Hateful , with a similar binary distribution across splits. The fine-grained labels are more imbalanced: Mocking is the most frequent hateful type and Exclusion the rarest; Sarcasm and Humor dominate the non-hateful subtypes.
blocks.zh:
在表1中,我们总结了四个数据分割。 在开发过程中,参与者接受了火车和电路培训,并提交了电路测试的预测。 之后我们发布了dev_test标签, 提供了4,500个标签的memes用于最终训练. 剩下的500米构成盲测试集.
在标注的拆分中,37.8%的memes是Hateful的,在拆分之间也有类似的二进制分布. 细纹的标签比较不平衡: 嘲笑是最常见的仇恨类型,最罕见的排斥类型;讽刺和幽默主导着非仇恨的子类型.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Examples from Track A with binary (A1) and fine-grained (A2) labels: the upper meme is Hateful–Contempt , and the lower meme is Not Hateful–Sarcasm . English glosses are shown below each meme.
blocks.zh: 图2 轨迹实例 A带有二进制(A1)和细纹(A2)标签:上层的mem是仇恨的-Contempt,下层的mem是非仇恨的-Sarcasm. 英文拼音在每一个meme下显示.

blocks.en: Table 1: Track A split sizes and label counts, including the blind test set. Fine-grained labels are multi-label, and Other applies to both binary classes.
blocks.zh: 表1:轨迹 分大小和标签计数,包括盲测试集. 细纹标签是多标签的,其他则适用于两个二进制类.

blocks.en: We use macro F1 as the official ranking metric for both subtasks. For A1, we average F1 over Hateful and Not Hateful . For A2, we compute F1 independently for each of the ten fine-grained labels and macro-average across them. This gives equal weight to frequent and rare classes. We additionally report accuracy, macro precision and recall, weighted F1, and per-class F1 for analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们使用宏F1作为两个子任务的官方排名衡量标准. 对A1,我们平均F1 超过仇恨和非仇恨。 对于A2,我们独立计算F1 对于10个精细的标签 和宏观平均。 这给予频繁和罕见的班级同等的分量. 我们还报告准确性、宏观精确性和召回性、加权F1和每级F1分析。

blocks.en: 3.2 Track B Textual Harmful Prompt Detection
blocks.zh: 3.2 音轨B 有害的快速检测

blocks.en: Track B evaluates whether Arabic prompts are safe for an LLM to answer and the harm domain they concern. It comprises two subtasks.
blocks.zh: 音轨 B评价阿拉伯语的提示对于LLM回答是否安全,以及它们所涉及的伤害领域. 它包括两个分任务。

blocks.en: • Subtask B1 performs binary classification between Safe and Unsafe . Unsafe prompts express explicit or implicit harmful intent, whereas safe prompts may discuss sensitive topics without requesting harmful actions. • Subtask B2 assigns each prompt in its task-specific evaluation pool to one of seven harm categories: Self-Harm , Harm to Others , Harassment , Fraud & Deception , Bullying , Hate Speech , and Adult Content . B2 is therefore a single-label, seven-way classification task independent of the B1 safety label.
blocks.zh: • 子任务B1对安全与不安全进行二进制分类。 不安全的提示表明明确或隐含的有害意图,而安全提示则可以讨论敏感议题而不要求采取有害行动。 • 次级任务B2将特定任务评价库中的每个提示分配给七个危害类别之一: 自我伤害、伤害他人、骚扰、欺诈和欺骗、欺凌、仇恨言论和成人内容。 B2因此是一个独立于B1安全标签的单标签,七向分类任务.

blocks.en: Subtask B1 performs binary classification between Safe and Unsafe . Unsafe prompts express explicit or implicit harmful intent, whereas safe prompts may discuss sensitive topics without requesting harmful actions.
blocks.zh: B1子任务执行安全与不安全之间的二进制分类. 不安全的提示表明明确或隐含的有害意图,而安全提示则可以讨论敏感议题而不要求采取有害行动。

blocks.en: Subtask B2 assigns each prompt in its task-specific evaluation pool to one of seven harm categories: Self-Harm , Harm to Others , Harassment , Fraud & Deception , Bullying , Hate Speech , and Adult Content . B2 is therefore a single-label, seven-way classification task independent of the B1 safety label.
blocks.zh: 子任务B2将特定任务评价池中的每个提示分配给七个伤害类别之一: 自我伤害、伤害他人、骚扰、欺诈和欺骗、欺凌、仇恨言论和成人内容。 B2因此是一个独立于B1安全标签的单标签,七向分类任务.

blocks.en: For this track we combine ArabicDialectSafety ( Zaghouani et al., 2026 ) and AraSafe ( Mubarak et al., 2025 ) . ArabicDialectSafety provides 21,066 manually annotated prompts across six Arabic varieties (MSA, Syrian, Egyptian, Algerian, Palestinian, and Moroccan); AraSafe adds 5,981 test-set prompts. Train and development splits draw only on ArabicDialectSafety, while the test set combines both sources, giving 27,047 prompts for B1. B2 uses a task-specific pool of 25,219 prompts. No prompts were duplicated across the two sources.
blocks.zh: 在这条赛道上,我们结合了ArabianDialectSafety(Zaghouani等人,2026年)和AraSafe(Mubarak等人,2025年)。 ArabianDialectSafety提供21,066个手动附加说明的提示,覆盖六个阿拉伯品种(MSA,叙利亚,埃及,阿尔及利亚,巴勒斯坦,摩洛哥);AraSafe增加了5,981个测试集提示. 列车与开发的分割只吸取了阿拉伯语DialectSafety,而测试集结合了两种来源,为B1提供了27,047个提示. B2使用任务专用集合25,219个提示. 这两个来源没有重复提示。

blocks.en: Several AraSafe granular labels denote the same concept under different names, so we re-encoded them to the ArabicDialectSafety scheme as follows: Safe → \rightarrow safe, Illegal Activities → \rightarrow Bully, Violence or Harm → \rightarrow harm-to-others, Privacy Violation → \rightarrow Fraud and Deception, Other Harmful Content → \rightarrow self-harm, Hate Speech → \rightarrow hate_speech, Explicit Content → \rightarrow harassment, and Misinformation → \rightarrow Fraud and Deception. The resulting AraSafe label distribution is safe (4,810), bully (476), harm-to-others (297), FraudandDeception (185), self-harm (102), hate_speech (82), and harassment (29).
blocks.zh: 多个AraSafe颗粒标签在不同名称下表示相同的概念,因此我们将它们重新编码为阿拉伯DialectSafety计划如下: 安全性 安全性 非法活动 安全性 安全性 暴力或伤害 安全性 安全性 安全性 安全性 安全性 安全性 安全性 安全性 由此产生的AraSafe标签分发是安全的(4,810),欺凌(476),伤害他人(297),欺诈和欺骗(185),自我伤害(102),仇恨(82)和骚扰(29)。

blocks.en: Some mappings were not exact, particularly harm-to-others, harassment, and Bully, which led systems to misclassify a small number of test items. The test set remained fully blind during the competition. We acknowledge this label-mapping discrepancy as a limitation and disclosed it to participants after the competition so they could address it in their system-description papers.
blocks.zh: 一些绘图不准确,特别是伤害他人,骚扰,和布利导致系统对少数测试项目进行错分类. 测试集在比赛期间仍然完全失明. 我们承认这种标签映射差异是一种限制,并在竞争结束后向参与者披露,以便他们在系统映射文件中予以处理。

blocks.en:
The inter-annotator agreement (Cohen’s κ \kappa ) on ArabicDialectSafety is 0.88 for safe/unsafe, 0.81 for harm categories ( Zaghouani et al., 2026 ) .
Figure 3 illustrates representative safe and unsafe prompts, including an unsafe prompt with its fine-grained harm category.
blocks.zh:
有关ArabDialectSafety的公证人协议(Cohen's $\kappa)是0.88,安全/不安全,0.81是伤害类别(Zaghouani等人,2026年)。
图3显示具有代表性的安全和不安全的诱因,包括具有微弱伤害类别的不安全诱因。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Examples from Track B illustrating binary safety label (B1) and fine-grained harm label (B2).
blocks.zh: 图3:轨道的实例 B说明二进制安全标签(B1)和细纹伤害标签(B2).

blocks.en: In Table 2 , we summarize the data splits and label distributions. Unsafe prompts dominate the train and development sets, while the test set is nearly balanced between Safe and Unsafe . The harm categories are also imbalanced, with Adult Content the most frequent and Hate Speech the least frequent.
blocks.zh: 在表2中,我们汇总数据分割和标签分布。 列车和开发装置主要使用不安全的提示, 伤害类别也不平衡,成人内容最频繁,仇恨言论最少。

blocks.en: We use macro-F1 as the official ranking metric for both subtasks. For binary prompt safety, we average F1 over Safe and Unsafe . For harm-category classification, we compute F1 for each of the seven harm categories and macro-average across them. We additionally report accuracy for analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们使用宏F1作为两个子任务的官方排名衡量标准. 为了二进制快速安全, 我们平均F1 超过安全和不安全。 关于伤害类别分类,我们计算七个伤害类别中的每个类别的F1和整个类别的宏观平均值。 我们还报告分析的准确性。

blocks.en: Table 2: Track B split sizes and label counts. B1 and B2 use different task-specific pools; the single-label B2 category counts therefore sum to the B2 pool sizes rather than to the B1 Unsafe counts.
blocks.zh: 表2: 轨迹 B 大小和标签计数。 B1和B2使用不同的任务特定集合;因此,单标签的B2类计数与B2的集合大小总和,而不是B1的不安全计数.

blocks.en: 4 Participating Systems
blocks.zh: 4 参与系统

blocks.en: We received 27 system-description papers from 35 participating teams. Tables 3 and 4 summarize the main model families and techniques, with further details in Appendix A . Submissions span Arabic pretrained encoders, vision-language models (VLMs), decoder LLMs, and lightweight lexical or classical approaches.
blocks.zh: 我们收到了35个参加小组的27份系统说明文件。 表3和表4概述了主要的模范家庭和技术,详见附录A。 提交材料涉及阿拉伯文预训编码器、视觉语言模型(VLMs)、解码器LLMs和轻量级词汇或古典方法。

blocks.en:
Table 3: Overview of participating systems and their main modeling choices. Other enc. groups additional Arabic and multilingual encoders; VLM and LLM denote vision-language and language models, respectively. Checks indicate components used in each team’s primary
submission.
blocks.zh:
表3:参与系统及其主要模式选择概述。 其他语种则分组额外的阿拉伯语和多语种编码器;VLM和LLM分别表示视觉语言和语言模型. 检查显示每个团队初级阶段使用的组件
提交。

blocks.en: Table 4: Overview of submitted systems and their main models and strategies. Detailed Track A and Track B approaches are provided in Tables 9 and 10 .
blocks.zh: 表4:所提交的系统及其主要模式和战略概览。 详细音轨 A和音轨 B 方法见表9和表10。

blocks.en: 4.1 Track A
blocks.zh: 4.1 A轨

blocks.en:
In this track, most systems combine an Arabic text encoder, typically MARBERTv2 or AraBERT, with visual representations from CLIP, SigLIP, ViT, or ResNet using late, gated, or attention-based fusion.
Several teams instead adapt VLMs such as Qwen3-VL, Llama-3.2-Vision, and Gemma 4 using LoRA or QLoRA
or classify LLM-derived embeddings. Text-only MARBERTv2 systems were also explored for binary hate detection. For fine-grained classification, systems frequently use multi-task learning, label-aware objectives, hierarchical constraints, ensembling, and class-specific threshold tuning
to address label imbalanced problem.
blocks.zh:
在这个音轨中,大多数系统结合了一个阿拉伯文本编码器,一般是MARBERTv2或ARABERT,其视觉表现来自CLIP,SigLIP,VIT,或ResNet使用晚期,门化,或基于注意力的聚变.
多个团队改用VLM,如Qune3-VL,Llama-3.2-Vision,Gemma 4使用LORA或QLORA
或分类LLM衍生嵌入物。 还探索了仅文本的MARBERTv2系统,用于二进制仇恨检测. 对于精细的分类,系统经常使用多任务学习,标签意识目标,等级约束,综艺,以及特定类的阈值调制.
解决标签不平衡的问题。

blocks.en:
The top-performing system, iMak AI Lab ( Lipinski and Makarov, 2026 ) , achieved a macro-F1 of 0.823 using an ensemble of 22 models: 18 Qwen3-VL-based VLMs and four Arabic text encoders based on MARBERTv2 and AraBERTv02-twitter. The VLM branch jointly processed each meme image and its OCR text, while the text branch used only the OCR-extracted content.
The text models were trained for binary hate detection with an auxiliary 10-class multi-label objective for the fine-grained categories. Final predictions combined the two branches at the probability level as P ⁡ ( Hateful ) = 0.85 ​ P ¯ VLM + 0.15 ​ P ¯ text P(\text{Hateful})=0.85\,\overline{P}_{\mathrm{VLM}}+0.15\,\overline{P}_{\mathrm{text}} . The system used only the official ArGuard data, without external data or augmentation.
blocks.zh:
顶级表现的系统iMak AI Lab(Lipinski and Makarov, 2026年),使用22个模型的组合实现0.823的宏F1:18 Quen3-VL基于VLM和四个基于MARBERTv2和AraBERTv02-twitter的阿拉伯语文本编码器. VLM分支联合处理每个meme图像及其OCR文本,而文本分支只使用OCR提取的内容.
文字模型接受了二进制仇恨检测培训,为精细分类设置了一个辅助的10级多标签目标. 最终预测将概率级的两个分支合并为PQQ(仇恨)=0.85 P'VLM+0.15 P'文本P(\text{Hateful})=0.85\,\overline{P}_{\mathrm{VLM}}+0.15\,\overline{P}_{\mathrm{text}}. 该系统仅使用官方的ArGuard数据,没有外部数据或增强.

blocks.en:
The top-performing A2 system, submitted by Ahmed Younis ( Younis, 2026 ) , used QCRI/MemeLens-VLM, a Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct model previously adapted for Arabic meme understanding. The model was further fine-tuned with LoRA while keeping the vision tower frozen, and the final hidden state was passed to a classification head rather than used for text generation.
The model was jointly trained for A1 and A2, producing one binary output for hate detection and 10 sigmoid outputs for the fine-grained categories. Class-weighted binary cross-entropy was used to address label imbalance. Final predictions were obtained by averaging probabilities from eight models trained with random seeds, including five trained on the official training set and three on the train and dev sets.
blocks.zh:
最高性能的A2系统由Ahmed Younis(Younis, 2026)提交,它使用了QCRI/MemeLens-VLM,一种以前为阿拉伯mem理解而改编的Quen3-VL-8B-指令模型. 该模型在保持视塔冷冻的同时与LORA进行了进一步的微调,最终的隐藏状态被传给一个分类头,而不是用于文本生成.
该模型是为A1和A2联合培训的,生产了用于检测仇恨的二进制输出和用于精细分类的10个西格莫德输出. 阶级加权的二进制交叉式用于解决标签不平衡问题. 最终预测是根据8个模型的平均概率得出的,这些模型经过随机种子培训,包括5个经过正式培训的模型和3个经过火车和dev培训的模型。

blocks.en: 4.2 Track B
blocks.zh: 4.2 轨道B

blocks.en:
For this track, systems rely primarily on Arabic encoders such as MARBERTv2, AraBERT, and CAMeLBERT, often combined through ensembling
or augmented with TF-IDF and character n n -gram features.
Other approaches include a fine-tuned Jais decoder,
ALLaM-based reasoning, translation followed by classification,
LLM embeddings, and lightweight lexical models. Several systems also incorporate dialect information explicitly through dialect-specific models, routing, or input prefixes.
blocks.zh:
对于这个音轨,系统主要依靠阿拉伯语编码器,如MARBERTv2,ARABERT,以及CAMELBERT,经常通过综艺组合.
或以 TF-IDF 和字符 n -gram 特性扩充。
其他方法包括精细的Jais解码器,
基于ALLAM的推理, 翻译后分类,
LLM嵌入,和轻量级的词典模型. 一些系统还明确通过方言特定模型,路由,或输入前缀来纳入方言信息.

blocks.en: Common Strategies. Across both tracks, common techniques include class-weighted or focal losses, multi-seed and multi-model ensembling, data augmentation, and threshold tuning. Several Track B systems additionally identify and correct the train-test class-prior shift, while others combine neural representations with sparse lexical features.
blocks.zh: 共同战略。 在这两条轨道上,通用技术包括课重或焦损失、多种子和多模式综艺、数据增强和阈值调制。 多个音轨 B系统还额外识别和纠正了列车测试班级前转向,而其他系统则将神经表达式与稀疏的词典特征相结合.

blocks.en:
The top-performing system, AK_QMUL ( Khairallah and Zubiaga, 2026 ) , adapted the Arabic-centric Jais-6.7B decoder using 4-bit QLoRA and a linear classifier over the final non-padding hidden state. Training used class-weighted cross-entropy and a final refit on the combined training and dev data.
Its main contribution was a dialect-factored objective. Instead of directly predicting safe or unsafe , the model predicted four classes: safe-MSA , safe-other , unsafe-MSA , and unsafe-other , which were collapsed to binary labels at inference. As safe-MSA was strongly underrepresented, the system augmented this class with human-written safe MSA prompts from AraSafe.
blocks.zh:
顶级表现的系统AKQQMUL(Khairallah and Zubiaga,2026年)对以阿拉伯为中心的Jais-6.7B解码器进行了改编,使用4位QLORA和一个线性分类器在最终的非铺设隐藏状态之上. 培训采用班级加权交叉操作方法,并最后更新综合培训和非数据。
其主要贡献是以方言为因素的目标。 该模型没有直接预测安全或不安全,而是预测了四类:安全-MSA(安全-MSA),安全-其他(安全-其他),不安全-MSA(不安全-MSA),和不安全-其他(不安全-其他),在推论中倒塌为二进制标签. 由于安全管理事务管理局代表人数严重不足,该系统通过AraSafe发出的人文安全管理事务协定提示,扩大了这一类别。

blocks.en:
For B2, AK_QMUL used the same Jais-6.7B backbone and QLoRA-based training setup as in B1, but replaced the dialect-factored objective with a direct seven-way classifier over the harm categories. No external data augmentation was used.
Final predictions were obtained by averaging the softmax probabilities from five models trained with different random seeds (42-46) and selecting the class with the highest mean probability. No additional stacking, threshold tuning, or post-processing was applied.
blocks.zh:
对于B2,AKQQMUL使用与B1相同的Jais-6.7B骨干和QLORA的训练设置,但用直接的七向分类器取代了由方言构成的目标,超越伤害类别. 没有使用外部数据扩增。
最终的预测是通过从5个接受不同随机种子(42-46)培训的模型中平均获得软最大概率,并选择平均概率最高的班级。 没有采用额外的堆叠、阈值调制或后处理。

blocks.en: 5 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: We report the official test results for the four subtasks. In total, the binary meme, fine-grained meme, binary prompt-safety, and harm-category subtasks received 16, 11, 22, and 17 submissions, respectively. All subtasks are ranked by macro-F1 with an organizer baseline. Section 4 summarizes participating systems and their main approaches.
blocks.zh: 我们报告四个子任务的官方测试结果 总共,二进制meme、精细的me、二进制即时安全以及伤害类子任务分别收到16、11、22和17份来文。 所有子任务都按照组织者基线的宏-F1排序. 第4节概述了参与制度及其主要做法。

blocks.zh: 表5:轨迹A子任务A1测试结果,按宏F1排名. 基线为阴影;粗体和下划线表示最佳和次佳分数。 * 没有提交系统说明文件。

blocks.zh: 表6:轨迹A子任务A2测试结果,按宏F1排名. 基线为阴影;粗体和下划线表示最佳和次佳分数。 * 没有提交系统说明文件。 QuadCore的A2提案没有在论文中描述。

blocks.zh: 表8:轨道B子任务B2测试结果,按宏F1排名. 基线为阴影,粗体表示最佳分数。 空间省略了精确度和召回度。 * 没有提交系统说明文件。

blocks.en: For binary hate detection (Table 5 ), the best system achieves 0.823 macro-F1 vs. 0.678 for the baseline, with all 16 submissions outperforming it. Text-only MARBERTv2 systems outperform many systems that fuse a text encoder with CLIP, SigLIP, ViT, or ResNet features, two teams found that adding image features hurt ( Hossain, 2026 ; Tonny et al., 2026 ) , and where fusion helped the gain was small ( Ilesanmi et al., 2026 ) , suggesting that OCR text carries most of the signal. The three best systems all fine-tune Qwen3-VL with LoRA on both modalities ( Al-Ani and Hassaan, 2026 ; Younis, 2026 ) , and the winner’s VLM ensemble outscores its own text-only ensemble by eight points ( Lipinski and Makarov, 2026 ) . Remaining errors concentrate on separating hateful Mocking from benign Sarcasm and Humor , which hinges on who is targeted ( Lipinski and Makarov, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 关于二进制仇恨检测(表5),最好的系统在基线方面达到0.823 macro-F1对0.678,所有16份呈文都优于它。 仅文本的MARBERTv2系统超过了许多将文本编码器与CLIP,SigLIP,VIT,或ResNet等特性连接起来的系统,两个团队发现添加图像特性有伤害(Hossain, 2026;Tonny等人, 2026),而聚变帮助得益的小(Ilesanmi等人, 2026),暗示OCR文本携带大部分信号. 三个最好的系统都与LORA在两种模式上进行Quen3-VL的微调(Al-Ani和Hassaan,2026年;Younis,2026年),获胜者VLM综艺以8分(Lipinski和Makarov,2026年)超越了自己的文本单曲综艺. 余下错误集中在将仇恨的嘲笑与良性讽刺和幽默区分开来,

blocks.en: Fine-grained meme classification (Table 6 ) is considerably more difficult, with the best system reaching 0.419 macro-F1 and 0.576 micro-F1. Performance is affected by severe class imbalance, with labels ranging from hundreds of Mocking examples to only a few Exclusion cases. The test set also differs from training, containing fewer hateful memes and more Humor , Sarcasm , and Contempt examples. To address this shift, Younis (2026) fine-tune class-specific decision thresholds and apply hierarchy-aware decoding. Other strong systems combine multimodal representations and ensembling, while Dynamos and DetectorsAI report particularly low performance on the rare Exclusion class ( Wahid et al., 2026 ; Al-Ani and Hassaan, 2026 ) . Overall, A2 shows that rare labels, distribution shift, and threshold calibration remain major challenges in fine-grained meme classification.
blocks.zh: 精细膜分类(表6)难度较大,最好的系统达到0.419宏F1和0.576微型F1. 性能受到严重阶级不平衡的影响,标签从数百个模拟例子到少数排除案例不等. 测试集也与训练不同, 为了应对这一转变,Younis(2026)微调了特定类别的决定阈值,并应用了等级意识解码. 其他一些强有力的系统将多式联运表述和综艺相结合,而Dynamos和DetectorsAI则报告说,稀有排斥类的绩效特别低(Wahid等人,2026年;Al-Ani和Hassaan,2026年)。 总体而言,A2显示,稀有的标签,分布位移,阈值校准仍然是精细膜分类的主要挑战.

blocks.en: We observe a similar gap between binary and fine-grained prompt classification. For binary detection (Table 7 ), AK_QMUL and Lattice AI both achieve 0.984 macro-F1 using different strategies: a fine-tuned Jais decoder and an ensemble of Arabic encoders, respectively. This shows that different model families can perform strongly on binary prompt safety.
blocks.zh: 我们观测到二进制和精细的快速分类之间的类似差距。 对于二进制检测(表7),AKQQMUL和Lattice AI都使用不同的策略分别实现0.984宏-F1:微调Jais解码器和阿拉伯编码器的组合. 这表明,不同的模范家庭可以在二进制即时安全上发挥强有力的作用.

blocks.en: The binary task also exhibits distribution shift, with unsafe prompts comprising about 80% of train and development data but only 49% of the test set. Several systems use threshold tuning or prior correction, highlighting the importance of calibration alongside representation learning.
blocks.zh: 二进制任务还显示分布转移,不安全的提示包括约80%的列车和开发数据,但只有49%的测试集. 一些系统采用阈值调试或事先校正,强调校准与代表性学习的重要性。

blocks.en: Fine-grained harm classification remains harder (Table 8 ), with the best system achieving 0.790 macro-F1 versus 0.687 for the baseline and only 0.002 separating the top two systems. Further gains may therefore require better discrimination between closely related harm categories.
blocks.zh: 精细的伤害分类仍然比较困难(表8),最好的系统实现0.790 宏-F1,而基线则为0.687,只有0.002将前两个系统分开. 因此,进一步的收益可能需要更好地区分密切相关的伤害类别。

blocks.en: Across both tracks, fine-grained classification is consistently harder than binary detection, with the largest gap observed for multimodal memes, and no single model family dominates across tasks. Multimodal and VLM-based ensembles lead the meme track, while both decoder LLMs and Arabic encoder ensembles perform strongly on prompt safety. Across submissions, class-aware training, ensembling, and threshold tuning are common among strong systems.
blocks.zh: 在这两条轨道上,精细的分类始终比二进制检测更难,在多式联运中观察到的最大差距,没有一个单一的模型家族在任务之间占主导地位。 多式联运和基于VLM的合唱团领导meme音轨,而解码器LLMs和阿拉伯编码器合唱团在快速安全上都表现强劲. 在所有呈件中,班级意识培训、综艺和门槛调整在强有力的系统中是常见的。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
We presented ArGuard 2026, a shared task covering two complementary Arabic content-safety tasks: harmful-content detection in multimodal memes and harmful-prompt detection for LLMs. Across four subtasks, 35 teams participated in the final evaluation and 27 submitted system-description papers, spanning Arabic encoders, multimodal models, VLMs, decoder LLMs, and lexical approaches.
Results show a clear gap between binary and fine-grained classification, with fine-grained meme understanding the most challenging. VLMs and multimodal ensembles perform well on memes, while Arabic encoder ensembles and a fine-tuned Jais decoder achieve strong prompt-safety results. Class-aware training, ensembling, and threshold tuning are common among competitive systems, while Track B highlights development–test distribution shifts.
Future work should improve coverage of rare hateful attack types, expand prompt-safety evaluation to more dialectal and code-switched Arabic, and study robustness across cultural contexts and data sources.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了 " ArGuard 2026 " 方案,这是一项共同的任务,涉及两项相辅相成的阿拉伯内容安全任务:在多式联运中检测有害物质和对LLMS进行有害瞬间检测。 在四个分任务中,35个小组参加了最后评价,27个小组提交了系统说明文件,涉及阿拉伯文编码器、多式联运模型、甚高频、解码器LLMs和词汇方法。
结果显示二进制分类和精细分类之间明显存在差距,精细的精细的精密体会到最具挑战性. VLM和多式联运组合在memes上表现良好,而阿拉伯编码器组合和一个精细的Jais解码器则取得了强大的快速安全效果. 班级意识训练、综艺和门槛调试在竞争系统中很常见,而B轨则强调发展-测试分配的转变。
今后的工作应当扩大罕见的仇恨攻击类型的覆盖面,将快速安全评价扩大到更多的方言和密码交换阿拉伯语,并研究不同文化背景和数据来源之间的稳健性。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: While ArGuard provides broad coverage across Arabic multimodal and prompt-safety settings, several areas remain for future extension. Track A’s fine-grained labels are highly imbalanced, and a few attack-strategy categories (e.g., Exclusion) contain relatively few training examples, which can make per-class estimates less stable. Track B currently covers six Arabic varieties, leaving additional dialects and code-switched text for future expansion.
blocks.zh: 虽然ArGuard在阿拉伯语的多式联运和快速安全环境下提供广泛的服务,但仍有一些领域有待今后推广。 音轨 A的精细标签高度不平衡,少数攻击策略类别(如排除)包含的训练实例相对较少,这可以使每级估计稳定性降低. 音轨 B目前涵盖6个阿拉伯语品种,为未来的扩展留下了额外的方言和代码切换文本.

blocks.en: Ethics and Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 道德操守和更广泛的影响

blocks.en: ArGuard releases memes and prompts that contain hateful, offensive, or otherwise harmful content, solely to support research on Arabic content moderation and LLM safety. We do not release any personal information beyond what already appears in the public source posts. Systems trained on this data can fail in both directions, missing harmful content or over-flagging benign content, so they should be used with human oversight rather than as an automated moderator.
blocks.zh: ArGuard发布含有仇恨、冒犯性或其他有害内容的迷因和提示,只是为了支持关于阿拉伯语内容温和和和LLM安全的研究。 我们不发布任何个人信息,除了公共来源已经出现的信息。 对这些数据进行培训的系统在两个方向上都可能失败,缺失有害内容或过度飘扬的良性内容,因此它们应该在人的监督下使用,而不是作为一个自动化的主持人.

blocks.en: Data Availability
blocks.zh: 数据可用性

blocks.en: We made the Task A dataset (AHA-Memes) publicly available for non-commercial research at https://huggingface.co/datasets/QCRI/AHA-MEMES . The Task B dataset is available through a controlled-access process at https://forms.gle/YUFdA16R6HkSZjp88 .
blocks.zh: 我们在https://huggingface.co/datasets/QCRI/AHA-MEMES上公布了A任务数据集(AHA-Memes)供非商业性研究使用。 通过https://forms.gle/YUFdA16R6HkSZjp88的可控访问程序可获取任务B数据集。

blocks.en: Appendix A Detailed System Descriptions
blocks.zh: 附录 详细系统说明

blocks.en: We provide a detailed overview of the submitted systems in Tables 3 - 10 . Tables 3 and 4 summarize the main models and approaches reported by each team, while Tables 9 and 10 provide more detailed descriptions for the meme and prompt tracks, respectively. The summaries are based primarily on the teams’ approach forms and supplemented with their system-description papers when needed.
blocks.zh: 我们对表3至表10中提交的系统作了详细概述。 表3和表4概述了每个小组报告的主要模式和方法,表9和表10则分别更详细地说明了中程轨道和快速轨道。 这些摘要主要以各小组的办法表格为基础,并在需要时补充其系统说明文件。

blocks.en: Table 9 shows considerable diversity in how teams combine textual and visual information. Many systems pair Arabic encoders such as MARBERTv2 or AraBERT with vision backbones including CLIP, SigLIP, ViT, and ResNet, using late, gated, or attention-based fusion. Other teams adapt vision–language models such as Qwen3-VL, Llama-3.2-Vision, and Gemma 4 with LoRA or QLoRA. A smaller set of submissions uses text-only Arabic encoders, enabling comparison with multimodal approaches. For the fine-grained task, common techniques include multi-task learning, class-aware losses, ensembling, and class-based threshold tuning.
blocks.zh: 表9显示了团队如何将文字信息和视觉信息结合起来的显著多样性。 许多系统将阿拉伯编码器,如MARBERTv2或AraBERT,配有视觉骨干,包括CLIP,SigLIP,VIT,以及ResNet,使用晚期,门化,或基于注意力的聚变. 其他队伍则会适应视觉-语言模型,如Qune3-VL,Llama-3.2-Vision,以及Gemma 4与Lora或QLORA. 一套较小的提交书只使用阿拉伯文文本编码器,便于与多式联运方法进行比较。 对于精细刻制的任务,常见的技巧包括多任务学习,班级意识损失,综艺,班级门槛调试.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 10 , Arabic pretrained encoders form the core of many prompt-safety systems, particularly MARBERTv2, AraBERT, and CAMeLBERT. Several teams combine these models through soft voting or other ensemble strategies, while others augment them with character n n -grams, TF-IDF, retrieval, or dialect features. The submissions also include different modeling paradigms, such as a fine-tuned JAIS decoder, ALLaM with self-taught reasoning, translation-based classification with DeepSeek-V4, and lightweight character n n -gram classifiers. Dialect conditioning, class-weighted training, and threshold or prior adjustment are also used by several teams.
blocks.zh: 如表10所示,阿拉伯预训编码器构成许多快速安全系统的核心,特别是MARBERTv2、AraBERT和CAMELBERT。 多个团队通过软投票或其他综艺策略将这些模式结合起来,而其他团队则通过字符n-gram,TF-IDF,检索,或方言特征来增强这些模式. 提交材料还包括不同的模型化范式,如精细的JAIS解码器,自学推理的ALLaM,DeepSeek-V4的基于翻译的分类以及轻量字符n-gram分类器. 数支球队也使用导盲调节,班级加权训练,以及阈值或前期调整.

blocks.en: Across the two tracks, submissions span both large generative models and lighter encoder- or feature-based classifiers. Despite this diversity, several techniques recur across systems, including class-aware training, multi-seed or multi-model ensembling, data augmentation, and threshold tuning. Track A systems additionally emphasize multimodal fusion and fine-grained label constraints, whereas Track B systems more often exploit dialect information, lexical features, and adjustments for differences between dev and test distributions.
blocks.zh: 在整个两个轨道上,提交材料既包括大型基因模型,也包括较轻的编码器或特征分类器。 尽管有这种多样性,但若干技术在系统之间重复出现,包括班级意识培训、多种子或多模式的综艺、数据增强和门槛调试。 音轨 一个系统进一步强调多式聚变和精细的标签限制,而轨道B系统则更经常地利用方言信息、词汇特征和调整dev和测试分布之间的差异。
